about.title: The infrastructure layer for modern travel businesses.
paragraphs: We aggregate inventory from global distribution systems, low-cost carriers, hotel chains, transfer suppliers and tour operators, then expose it through one normalized REST API. Connect once and reach a worldwide supply network without negotiating individual contracts or juggling data formats.

We are a technology intermediary, not a travel operator. Bookings are fulfilled by the underlying suppliers; we provide the connectivity, normalization and developer experience so your team can focus on product, not plumbing.

faqs.question: What is this platform?
faqs.answer: A unified travel API that gives you flights, hotels, transfers, activities, tour packages, eSIM and more through one normalized REST integration.

faqs.question: Who is it for?
faqs.answer: OTAs, TMCs, corporate booking tools, travel-tech startups, loyalty programs and AI travel agents.

faqs.question: What inventory does the API support?
faqs.answer: Flights (GDS, NDC and LCC), hotels, transfers, activities, tour packages, lounges, fast track, meet & greet and eSIM.

faqs.question: How long does integration take?
faqs.answer: Most teams make their first sandbox booking within a day and go live within two to six weeks.

faqs.question: Are you a travel agent or an infrastructure provider?
faqs.answer: An infrastructure provider. Bookings are fulfilled by the underlying suppliers; we provide connectivity and normalization.

faqs.question: How is data secured?
faqs.answer: TLS everywhere, encrypted storage, scoped API keys, IP allow-listing and audit logs.

faqs.question: How do I get API access?
faqs.answer: Request access, book a short kick-off call and receive sandbox credentials the same day.

blocks.title: The new standard for airline retailing
paragraphs: New Distribution Capability (NDC) is an XML standard that lets airlines sell rich offers directly to agencies: branded bundles, ancillaries and dynamic prices that legacy channels can't carry.
Each airline implements NDC differently. We connect to them once, normalize their offers and give you a single schema shared with GDS and low-cost content.
